contexts.text: Under Dart, see these references. AC 2709. AC 2709:4. AC 6421. AE 357.
The arrows of Jehovah are sharp, and all His bows are bent ()... Arrows = spiritual truths.
The bow with the arrows () = doctrine and its truths: truths themselves, when separated from goods, in the other life appear... as darts.
The arrow that flieth by day () = the falsity which is openly taught, by which good is destroyed. AC 7102:10. AC 9642:5.
Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent. Arrows = the doctrinal things of falsity from which the combat is waged. AC 8215:3.
The arrow which shall go forth as the lightning () = the truth Divine which reproves and penetrates.
A shield, and the shafts which belong to a bow = truths of doctrine from the Word, by means of which there is protection from the falsities of evil. References.
It is like a shaft let go from a bow, which, if at first it should decline ever so little from the mark, at the distance of a mile would diverge immensely. (See also Dart, at DP 333.)
The Divine truth from the Divine good is... as a bow with arrows...
Arrows, etc. () = all things which belong to doctrine. To kindle fire with them seven years = to completely consume them all by means of evils.
The arrows which went abroad () mean lightnings, whereby there appear as it were arrows from a bow, which are present when there are thunder and lightning, and by these are signified Divine truths.
The falsities which are known to be falsities are meant by the arrow that flieth by day.
The arrows which are sharp, and the bows which are bent = falsities of doctrine prepared for the destruction of truths. AE 357:21.

Their enlightenment in truths is described by these words, His arrow shall go forth as the lightning, and the Lord Jehovih shall sound with the trumpet, and shall march in the storms of the south. The arrow which shall go forth as the lightning = truth enlightened; thus truth from the good of love.
A pure shaft () = truth dispersing evil.
Under Arrow, see this reference.
They make ready the arrow upon the string () = that they fit falsities into doctrine which appear like truths.
They stretch their arrow with a bitter word, in order to shoot the upright in secret ()... As an arrow = falsity of doctrine, it is said, they stretch their arrow with a bitter word.
His arrows as of a strong one, there shall not return anything vain () = that they will thence be imbued with mere falsities.
He prepares the vessels of death, and makes his arrows burning () = that he makes for himself principles of falsity from infernal love, whereby he destroys good and its truths.
The bow with the arrows () = doctrine with its falsities.

That then genuine truths and goods do not appear to them, but in their place fatuous truths and goods, which in themselves are falsities and evils, is signified by For light thine arrows go abroad, for resplendence the thunderbolt of thy spear (). Arrows, or lightnings = fatuous truths which in themselves are falsities.
The arrow which shall go forth as the lightning = truth dispersing and destroying.
Thine arrows went abroad () = Divine truths thence derived.
Arrows () = truths combating.

Sons of the youth which are like arrows in the hand of a mighty one () = the truths of the Ancient Church, which were natural truths from the Spiritual; this Church is meant by youth; and as these truths possess all power against falsities and evils, it is said, as arrows in the hand of a mighty one; arrows = truths which destroy falsities.
